{{short description|American mathematician|bot=PearBOT 5}}
'''Todd Arbogast''' is an American mathematician. He is a professor of mathematics at the [[University of Texas at Austin]], where he is a W. A. "Tex" Moncrief, Jr. Simulation-Based Engineering and Sciences Professor and Frank E. Gerth III Faculty Fellow. His research concerns the [[numerical analysis]] of [[partial differential equation]]s.<ref name="profile">[http://users.oden.utexas.edu/~arbogast/cv.pdf], CV Univ. of Texas Dept. of Statistics and Data Sciences], retrieved 2014-12-20.</ref>

Arbogast did his undergraduate studies at the [[University of Minnesota]], in mathematics and physics, graduating in 1981.<ref name="profile"/>
He received his  Ph.D. in mathematics from the [[University of Chicago]] in 1987 under the supervision of [[Jim Douglas, Jr.]]<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=51731|title=Todd Arbogast}}</ref>

In 2012, Arbogast became a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society]</ref>
